title: Chupa Chupa beams at Colares

tellings.quote: As it was flying, the object would cast down a beam of light.

plain: In 1977, in the small town of Colares in northern Brazil, people reported flying objects, known locally as "Chupa Chupa", that shot beams of light down at the ground as they flew. Aldo Rebelo, a former Brazilian defense minister, tells it on the show: "As it was flying, the object would cast down a beam of light." Coming from a former minister, it would mean the Brazilian state takes the case seriously.
